Purple Style Labs' Stock Debut Sees Significant Drop

Purple Style Labs' initial public offering saw its stock price fall on its debut. The company's shares experienced a loss of approximately ₹40 per share on the listing day. This marked a subdued start for the fashion retailer's entry into the public market.
